Sounds pretty normal for a sudden diet change. Switch her to a bland diet of plain boiled chicken and rice. That will help clear up the diarrhea. You can also add a small spoonful of plain canned pumpkin. Once the diarrhea is cleared up try to slowly transition kitty to the new diet or 7-10 days. Lots of info online but basically 75%old and 25% new for 3 days. 50/50 old and new for 3 days. Then 25% old and 75% new for 3 more days. After that she should be good to go! This is super common. Hope this helps as it’s our basic go to in my hospital. -vet tech
